title: Growth and Development Pace
question_text: How should government manage population growth and new development?

stances.text: Hold the pace of growth down — cap major new development, and let residents vote directly on the largest projects.
Allow growth only as fast as current infrastructure can handle — make new development wait for capacity.
Welcome steady growth — invest in roads, water and schools ahead of demand so expansion isn't held back.
Actively push for faster growth — cut red tape and recruit new development, while keeping basic guardrails.
Step back and let the market set the pace — remove development constraints beyond basic health and safety.

title: Jail Capacity and Incarceration Alternatives
question_text: How should government respond to jail overcrowding and criminal justice demand?

stances.text: Redirecting incarceration funding into community-based mental health, addiction, housing, and restorative justice programs to shrink the jail system
Reducing the incarcerated population through alternatives to incarceration rather than building new capacity
Upgrading jail facilities only as needed to meet constitutional standards, without expanding overall capacity
Building additional jail capacity to address overcrowding and facility deficiencies
Expanding jail capacity as the primary response to crime, prioritizing detention over alternatives

title: Online Misinformation and Content Moderation
question_text: What responsibility do platforms and government have in combating online misinformation?

stances.text: legally require platforms to remove false information
require platforms to label false content, rather than remove it
encourage voluntary standards for combating misinformation online
protect free speech online and prevent government censorship
ban any government involvement in content moderation decisions

title: Rent Regulation
question_text: What role should government play in regulating rents and protecting tenants?

stances.text: Expand rent control to cover all rental units communitywide
Strengthen existing rent stabilization and extend coverage to more units
Maintain current tenant protections while allowing market rents for new construction
Limit rent regulations to subsidized units; allow market rents broadly
Oppose rent control entirely; rents should be set by the market without government intervention

title: Social Security
question_text: How should Social Security be funded and structured for the future?

stances.text: expand Social Security benefits significantly and remove the income cap on payroll taxes to fund it.
increase Social Security benefits modestly while raising taxes on higher earners to strengthen the program.
make small adjustments to both benefits and taxes to keep Social Security stable for future generations.
gradually reduce future benefits rather than raise taxes to keep Social Security solvent.
transition Social Security to private investment accounts that individuals control themselves.

title: Ukraine - Russia Conflict
question_text: What level of military and financial support should be provided to Ukraine?

stances.text: significantly increase military and financial aid to Ukraine.
continue providing current levels of military and economic aid to help Ukraine defend itself.
provide limited humanitarian aid to Ukraine while encouraging diplomatic negotiations to end the war.
reduce aid to Ukraine and focus American resources on domestic priorities instead.
end all aid to Ukraine immediately and stay completely out of the conflict.

title: 2020 Presidential Election
question_text: What is your view of the outcome of the 2020 presidential election?

stances.text: The election was fair and Joe Biden won legitimately.
Joe Biden won, but the election had real problems worth fixing.
There was some fraud, but not enough to change the result.
Fraud or irregularities may have been enough to change the result.
The election was stolen from Donald Trump through widespread fraud.

title: Border Security
question_text: How should the government handle people who cross the border?

stances.text: Give everyone who crosses the border a fair asylum hearing.
Expand orderly, legal ways to seek asylum at the border.
Combine strong enforcement with a faster asylum process.
Sharply restrict who can claim asylum at the border.
End asylum and quickly turn back anyone who crosses illegally.

title: Cannabis Policy
question_text: How should the government regulate cannabis?

stances.text: Keep cannabis fully illegal and enforce criminal penalties for possessing or selling it.
Allow cannabis only for medical use, available to patients with a physician's authorization.
Remove criminal penalties for personal possession, replacing them with civil fines, but keep commercial sales illegal.
Legalize recreational cannabis and regulate it through a licensed, taxed commercial market.
Legalize cannabis and treat it like an ordinary legal product, with minimal restrictions on growing and using it.

title: Defense Spending
question_text: How much should the government spend on the military?

stances.text: Increase military spending substantially, launching a major buildup to expand the armed forces and their capabilities.
Increase military spending moderately, growing the budget above inflation to keep pace with rising threats.
Hold military spending roughly flat, allowing it to rise only with inflation.
Reduce military spending modestly below current levels.
Cut military spending dramatically, roughly halving the budget or more.

title: Foreign Military Intervention
question_text: How should the United States use military force abroad?

stances.text: Use US military power to actively lead and police conflicts around the world.
Intervene militarily when clear US interests or allied nations are directly threatened.
Prefer diplomacy and economic sanctions, using military force only as a last resort.
Avoid overseas military action except to defend US territory from direct attack.
Withdraw from overseas military commitments and end foreign military intervention.

title: U.S. Military Aid to Israel
question_text: What level of military aid should the U.S. provide to Israel?

stances.text: Continue full military aid to Israel with no new conditions.
Continue aid to Israel, but require it to comply with humanitarian and human-rights law.
Block offensive weapons sales while continuing defensive support such as missile defense.
Sharply cut military aid to Israel as a step toward ending it.
End all military aid to Israel.

title: Minimum Wage
question_text: What approach should government take to the minimum wage?

stances.text: Raise the wage floor and tie it to the cost of living, so it rises automatically each year without new legislation.
Raise the wage floor to a set higher level, then adjust it only when lawmakers vote to.
Keep a modest national wage floor as a baseline and let states and cities set higher rates.
Hold the wage floor at its current level and let the market set pay above it.
Remove the wage floor entirely and let employers and workers set pay by agreement.

title: Ranked-Choice Voting and Electoral Method
question_text: How should votes be cast and counted in elections?

stances.text: Replace winner-take-all elections with proportional ranked-choice voting — ranked ballots fill several seats at once, so seats reflect how everyone voted.
Adopt ranked-choice voting for single-winner offices: voters rank candidates, and if a top choice can't win, the vote shifts to the next choice until someone has a majority.
Allow ranked-choice voting where communities choose it, while keeping single-choice voting as the standard.
Keep single-choice voting and oppose adopting ranked-choice voting, but stop short of banning it.
Ban ranked-choice voting by law.
